20245.long_desc:
This Desktop Mount Monitor Standis the perfect accessory for 15 inch monitors, offering convenience and functionality at an affordable price! It seamlessly blends into any décor and is designed with a VESA plate and keyhole slots for easy assembly. 

With the ability to rotate between landscape and portrait orientations, users can enjoy an optimal viewing experience. The mount also features tilt and swivel adjustments, allowing to find the perfect viewing angle. Additionally, integrated cable management keeps a clean and organized look, while protective pads on the base bottom prevent scratches.
